title: OKF domain profile v1
description: A bounded, evidence-bearing handoff from domain research to an OKF bundle build. It is a control document, not the resulting knowledge graph.

deterministicEligibilityRule.description: Trimmed, control-free rule that deterministically selects the complete declared candidate inventory from the frozen source snapshot.

eligible_count.description: Count admitted by the eligibility rule before evidenced exclusions; it must equal the four disjoint coverage outcomes.

candidate_ids.description: Stable source-native or repository-controlled identifiers for the exact candidates admitted by the eligibility rule; the list length must equal eligible_count.

candidate_list_sha256.description: SHA-256 of sorted candidate_ids encoded as one compact UTF-8 JSON array (ensure_ascii=false, separators comma and colon) followed by one LF byte; an approved profile cannot use unknown.

source_snapshot_id.description: Exact input_snapshot.snapshot_id from which the eligibility rule derives this candidate universe.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence for the candidate extraction and completeness assessment.

predicate_iri.description: Predicate governed with mapping_relation: each SKOS relation uses its matching SKOS mapping predicate, identity uses the approved identity predicate set, and domain relationships exclude both sets.

target_namespace.description: Governed HTTP origin plus path or trailing-hash namespace containing every assertion target under URI-aware membership rules.

coverage_result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete sibling coverage_result encoded as canonical UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, retained array order, ensure_ascii=false, compact comma/colon separators and one trailing LF byte.

eligible_count.description: Exact copy of the referenced denominator's eligible count.

linked_count.description: Eligible candidates with an asserted, evidence-backed external link.

linked_candidate_ids.description: Exact eligible candidates with one or more asserted, evidence-backed external links.

linked_assertion_count.description: Total external link assertions made for linked candidates; this may exceed linked_count when one candidate has more than one asserted link.

link_assertions.description: Identity-bearing ledger of every external link assertion counted by this result.

unresolved_count.description: Eligible candidates for which no sufficiently evidenced link has yet been established.

unresolved_candidate_ids.description: Exact eligible candidates for which no sufficiently evidenced link has been established.

excluded_count.description: Candidates removed from the effective coverage denominator by an evidenced exclusion.

exclusion_results.description: Exact evidence-bearing reconciliation of every counted exclusion.

conflicting_count.description: Eligible candidates with conflicting evidence that prevents one governed link from being asserted.

conflicting_candidate_ids.description: Exact eligible candidates whose conflicting evidence prevents a governed link assertion.

achieved_coverage_percent.description: Linked count divided by eligible count minus excluded count, rounded half-up to two decimal places; 100 when the effective denominator is zero.

results.description: One identity-bound dereference outcome for every link assertion.

observed_at.description: Time at which the coverage and dereference observations were made; an approved result binds this exact instant to approval-grade, digest-bound result evidence.

freshness_status.description: Status calculated from observed_at, maximum_age_days and the profile prepared_at clock.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence for the complete coverage observation. Approved semantic ledgers accept only support-checked or independently verified, digest-bound evidence.

candidate_ids.description: Stable source-native or repository-controlled identifiers for the exact candidates excluded by this rule; count must equal the number of identifiers, and identifiers cannot occur in another exclusion result.

target_iri.description: External target within the parent link set's governed target_namespace. A candidate-target pair can occur only once in that link set.

terminal_kind.description: Machine-readable terminal result. HTTP 200-399 derives succeeded; every other terminal result derives failed.

http_status.description: Terminal HTTP response status, or null for a non-HTTP terminal failure.

observed_status.description: Human-readable accompaniment; it does not determine outcome.

message.const: This is an incomplete research view, not an authoritative service or released data product. Content and links may change. Check the cited official source before making a decision.
